files.schemas/items.schema.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "items",
  "title": "Sample item",
  "description": "A synthetic schema for the replay fixtures.",
  "$defs": {
    "sid": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z][0-9a-km-np-z]{2}$"},
    "deep": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sid"}
  },
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["title", "status"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string", "minLength": 3},
    "status": {"enum": ["open", "done", 1, null, [1], {"k": 1}]},
    "kind": {"const": "task"},
    "rank": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9},
    "score": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0.5, "maximum": 1e20},
    "goal": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sid"},
    "alias": {"$ref": "#/$defs/deep"},
    "tags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": ["string", "null"]}},
    "when": {"oneOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "integer"}, {"type": "number"}]},
    "flags": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "boolean"}},
    "note": {"type": ["string", "uuid"]},
    "free": {"type": "object"},
    "format": {"type": "string"},
    "cfg": {"const": {"a": [1, 2]}},
    "label": {"enum": ["é", "x"]},
    "slug": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(ab|cd)+-[a-z]?x*$"}
  }
}
